critic.fix_suggestion: For the 'Main cabin window row', replace the single continuous dark line with an array of 20 individual rectangular planes. Each plane should have dimensions of 0.5 units (width) by 1.2 units (height), spaced at a constant interval of 0.3 units along the fuselage's longitudinal axis, centered on the existing line's path.

discrepancies.reference: A series of distinct individual rectangular windows
